page: Microsoft Azure D4nds_v6 is a general-purpose, network-optimized virtual machine running on the Microsoft Hyper-V hypervisor. The instance is powered by an x86_64 Intel processor and is provisioned with 4 dedicated virtual CPUs. System memory totals 16.0 GB, maintaining a standard 1:4 vCPU-to-memory allocation of 4.0 GB per core. It operates without discrete GPU hardware accelerators.

For local I/O requirements, the D4nds_v6 includes 236 GB of bundled local NVMe SSD storage alongside support for Premium Storage. This integrated high-speed solid-state disk provides direct read and write access for temporary data, swap space, and scratch processing. Networking features are optimized for the Dndv6 family, though complimentary public IPv4 addresses are not included with the base instance configuration.

In terms of cost efficiency and hardware tradeoffs, the inclusion of 236 GB local NVMe storage reduces reliance on external attached volumes for ephemeral data. With balanced memory density and dedicated compute allocations, the instance delivers predictable resource availability without oversubscription penalties. The primary architectural tradeoff centers on storage persistence, as local NVMe drives are designed for non-persistent caching and scratch workloads.

The resource footprint makes the instance suitable for mid-tier web serving, application backends, continuous integration pipelines, local caching layers, and database workloads that leverage local NVMe storage for tempdb or ephemeral operations.
description: The Microsoft Azure D4nds_v6 is a general-purpose, network-optimized virtual machine designed for balanced compute and storage workloads. Configured with an x86_64 Intel processor, the instance provides 4 dedicated vCPUs alongside 16.0 GB of memory, yielding 4.0 GB per core. The server includes 236 GB of local NVMe SSD storage and supports Premium Storage options, offering low-latency disk throughput for operations requiring fast temporary data retention. It features no GPU hardware acceleration and provides no complimentary public IPv4 addresses. Delivering dedicated compute slices on the Microsoft Hyper-V platform, the D4nds_v6 maintains consistent processing throughput without core sharing. Its bundled high-speed NVMe storage provides a cost-effective design for scratch-heavy pipelines, eliminating the overhead of attached network volumes for ephemeral caching. This hardware profile makes the instance well matched for medium web application tiers, CI/CD runners, caching instances, and relational database systems that rely on high-speed scratch space.
